Proposition
1. ch5:5.15

On a Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold, the connections induced by the Levi-Civita connection on tensor bundles are compatible with the induced inner products: for $X\in \mathfrak X(M)$ and $F,G\in \Gamma (T^{(k,l)}TM)$, \[ X\langle F,G angle =\langle abla _XF,G angle +\langle F, abla _XG angle . \]

Proof

\sketch Reduce by linearity to decomposable tensors $F=\alpha _1\otimes \cdots \otimes \alpha _{k+l}$ and $G= eta _1\otimes \cdots \otimes eta _{k+l}$, then apply the tensor-product rule and the vector/covector metric-compatibility identities in (2.15).
